description: LKW-Parkplatzbelegung Hamburger Hafen is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Hamburg Port Authority AöR. Dynamic (short-term changeable / here residual space capacity) information about the parking spaces is recorded. The remaining space capacities relate to truck parking spaces and are determined by means of accounting procedures. Coverage: Hamburg Port Authority AöR. The portal shows the English title as "Truck parking lot occupancy Hamburger Hafen" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Hamburg Port Authority AöR. The listing shows 2023-11-06 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
